name: Chairman
source: A senior priest of the Cleanup Department who [url=https://vndb.org/c103282]Belial[/url] meets early on alongside [url=https://vndb.org/c103284]Blondie[/url]. Short-tempered and fond of gossiping, she's also one of the many half-siblings of [url=https://vndb.org/c103276]Maya[/url] and one of her older sisters.
